main_text.p: arbitrium bonorum virorum & statim,& suis fumptibus,ceffantefque in hoc officio M.icu-tatos veteres in ufum apparatus bellici pen-derent: tumultuantes comprimerentur ma-turé:si qui turbata pace publica ceperint alios, ac fpoliarint, captos dimitterent confeftim, fpolioque dupliciter reftituro infuper gravem multam fœderi luerent: fine confenfu com-muni bellum nemo moveret: in auxilium evocati à fociis fidei firmandæ caufa obfides traderent Groningæ cuftodiendos ufque ad expeditionis finem. Tum, de judicijs fic. Iudicibus in agro aut jus reddere detrectanti-bus, aut petperam judicantibus, jus effet læfo appellare tribunal fuperius, in quo judicant omnes totius focietatis ordines legitimé convocati, ejufque appellationis teftimonium fcriptum petere GRONINGÆ intra diem x. quo accepto, non liceret judici inferiori quicquam in eum porro decernere,aut contra eum agere, aut repetenti pignora, fi qua fint ablata,ac fponfionem præftare volenti in mo-ra aut impedimento effe: aut illum diem fi negligeret læfus, omnino judicato priori pa-reret: appellans caufam fuam perfequeretur tribus proximis in conventibus judicialibus in ipfa urbe,aut marcas penderet veteres quinque mulctæ nomine, infuperque caufa fua caderet: atque hic effet litium trahendarum terminus, nec fas efset in hoc quicquam mutare, nifi ex mutuo litigantium partium confenfu: judex inferior, à cujus judicio provocatum efset, fi non veniret ipfe tuendæ fententiæ fuæ gratia ad conventum, primum detrimento id non efset appellanti, deinde præ-

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page and scan edges at the margins are not transcribed. The catchword "ter" at the foot is doubtful. The initial word "IN AGRVM VICINVM." was normalised to u/v spelling. The ligature in "mulctæ" is read as ct. Ink damage at the right edge; no marginal notes are printed on this page.
